faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started
faq.support: Still have questions? Talk to our

q1.question: What is Dify?
q1.answer: We're your agent team that works while you sleep. We research, write, analyze data, connect tools, schedule tasks — all through conversation. It's like having a team of smart assistants available 24 hours a day.

q2.question: Do I need to know how to code?
q2.answer: No. Everything works through plain language conversation. Automated recipes come ready-made, agents are pre-configured, and connections are plug-and-play.

q3.question: Which AI models do you use?
q3.answer: We work with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, local models via Ollama, and 100+ models via OpenRouter. You choose which one we use for each situation.

q4.question: Is my data secure?
q4.answer: Yes. Each workspace is completely isolated from others. Passwords are encrypted, we have active security protections, and we automatically detect sensitive data.

q5.question: Can I connect the tools I already use?
q5.answer: Yes. We have 50+ ready-made connections — WhatsApp, databases, GitHub, Notion, Google Calendar, and much more. And if you need something specific, we create custom connections.

q6.question: How does the agent team work?
q6.answer: We're specialized agents — a researcher, a writer, an analyst, a dev. Each of us has our own way of working and our own tools. We talk to each other, split tasks, and work together. You follow everything on a real-time visual dashboard.
